name: browser-use
headline: Deep Research Kit: Multi-Agent Research
short_description: AI-powered deep research skill that deploys parallel agents to verify sources, cross-check facts, and generate citation-backed reports with structured outputs.
author: fivetaku

sections.overview:
Deep Research Kit turns single questions into comprehensive, citation-backed research reports using parallel AI agents. It deploys 3-5 simultaneous agents across web, academic, and technical sources, then cross-verifies key claims against multiple sources to minimize hallucinations. Every factual claim includes inline citations, and sources are graded A–E by credibility. The skill generates executive summaries, full sectioned reports, bibliographies, and optional interactive websites automatically. Research sessions are resumable via saved state, making it ideal for complex investigations where source quality and fact-checking matter.
Market research and competitive analysis with verified sources
Academic literature reviews with peer-reviewed paper prioritization
Technical documentation synthesis from official specs and standards
Fact-checking and claim verification across multiple independent sources
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/fivetaku/deep-research-kit`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a research assistant. I need a comprehensive analysis of [TOPIC] in the [INDUSTRY]. Focus on [ASPECT] and provide insights based on [DATA SOURCES]. Include recent trends, key players, and potential opportunities. Format the output with clear headings and bullet points.
```
